mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that significantly increases metabolism of tetrabenazine and its active metabolites (alpha- and beta-dihydrotetrabenazine), reducing tetrabenazine plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced tetrabenazine efficacy; consider increasing tetrabenazine dose or selecting an alternative antimycobacterial agent if clinically feasible; therapeutic drug monitoring may be warranted.
